Student VolunteersPOPL 2026

  • About

Call for student volunteers

Sign up to be a Student Volunteer and help us make POPL 2026 a unique experience for all attendants!

POPL 2026 is pleased to offer a number of opportunities for student volunteers, who are vital to the efficient operation and continued success of the conference each year. The student volunteer program is a chance for students from around the world to participate in the conferences whilst assisting us in preparing and running the event.

The Student Volunteer Program helps more students attend the POPL conference by covering registration to the conferences, tutorials, workshops, and all associated events (but not travel or lodging expenses). In exchange for a fixed number of work hours (around 18) helping with the conference organization, you will be able to closely interact with researchers, mentors, and other students at POPL 2026. We are looking forward to seeing you in the SV team!

Eligibility

Applicants can be undergraduate, Master’s, Ph.D. full- or part-time students, of computer science or related fields, with or without previous experience as volunteers. Everyone is encouraged to apply!

Duration

Applicants must be available for at least four (4) full days between the 11th and 17th of January 2026, and will be expected to provide at least 18 hours of volunteering work in that time. Volunteers will also be expected to be available for some amount of pre-conference discussion and training if necessary.

Compensation

Every student volunteer will receive:

  • A complimentary conference registration, offering access to all open sessions (i.e., parallel paper presentations, demonstrations, and workshops) and conference proceedings.
  • Free lunches and refreshments during breaks.
  • Student volunteer garments.

Please note that Student Volunteers are responsible for their own travel and accommodation arrangements. However, Student Volunteers can apply for extra funding from SIGPLAN PAC funding or PLMW when eligible.

You can send questions about student volunteering to Aurèle Barrière (aurele.barriere@epfl.ch) and Stephen Mell (sm1@cis.upenn.edu).

Applications

To apply, fill out the form on this link, before November 10th: https://forms.gle/YiMy1PXVF6QWggsb8 . The form is very short and won’t take more than 5 minutes to complete. We will NOT evaluate the applications in a first come first serve order.

Deadline for submission: November 10th 2025, AoE.

The application has now ended and the students have been selected. If you have been selected, please answer the form you received by email by Wednesday, November 26th AoE.
